title: Identifying Singaporeans Involved in Overseas Vape Production or Distribution Networks
what_it_is: Identifying Singaporeans Involved in Overseas Vape Production or Distribution Networks

sections.label: Overseas vape enforcement cooperation
sections.summary: Singapore works with overseas counterparts on illegal vape activities, but cooperation is limited where such activities are legal, so no data is kept on involved Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazlina Abdul Halim
sentences.text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health (a) whether local enforcement agencies work with their overseas counterparts to identify Singaporeans involved in overseas vape production or distribution networks; and (b) what enforcement action can be taken against such persons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: That said, we work with our overseas counterparts to share information on illegal activities and conduct joint operations from time to time.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: However, if vape production, distribution and consumption are not illegal in those countries, cooperation will be limited.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hazlina Abdul Halim (East Coast)
sentences.text: Could the Minister of State share how many Singaporeans have since been identified through these cooperations and the enforcement taken out of these cooperations as well?

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Therefore, foreign authorities would generally not take enforcement action against individuals for such activities nor systematically share such information with us.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: So, we have very limited information on that.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And consequently, we do not have data, we do not maintain data on the number of Singaporeans who may be involved in vape production or distribution overseas, or on related overseas enforcement actions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: But where we do come across information suggesting breaches of Singapore's laws, we do then look at the information and take appropriate follow-up actions within its enforcement remit.
